newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/BIG STRADDLE IN FEDERATED TRADES.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/BIG STRADDLE IN FEDERATED TRADES.

text.p: A sizable straddle crossed in Federated Department Stores Inc Wednesday, highlighting trade that was otherwise dominated by investors rolling positions out of August options into September.
The Federated September 40 call traded about 10,000 contracts and the same put traded 11,600.
"They bought the straddle 8,500 times," said Harrison Roth, a first vice president at Cowen & Co, adding that the investor may have done more on the put side.
In afternoon trading, Federated shares were down 9/16 at 42-1/2.

In other trading, put buyers were active in Micron Technology Inc options as the stock fell sharply after Merrill Lynch and Brown Brothers Harriman downgraded the stock, citing lower prices of 16 megabyte memory chips.

"We had a lot of put buyers yesterday ahead of Merrill's downgrade," said Rob Kovell, a market maker in Micron options at the Pacific Exchange. "The stock opened down big this morning and we had people continuing to buy puts even down here."
Micron shares were down 7-3/16 at 42-15/16 on heavy turnover of about 18 million shares.
Micron puts and calls were busy from the August series down to the January.
Activity was led by the August 45 calls, which traded a total of 7,580 contracts. Those options, which expire Friday, were down 4-3/8 at 5/8 at the Pacific Exchange, where 5,760 traded.
Micron options trade at the Pacific Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange.
The August 40 puts traded 4,915 and the August 42-1/2 puts traded 3,370. The September 45 and 50 calls each traded more than 4,100 contracts.
Much of the other activity Wednesday was from investors rolling August positions, which expire Friday, into other months.

For example, the Boston Chicken Inc August 10 and September 10 calls each traded 4,200 contracts, the August 15 and September 15 puts each traded around 1,000 and the August 17-1/2 and September 17-1/2 each traded "There have been some big spreads. Customers were rolling out to September," a market maker in the options at the CBOE said.
Other rolling action was spotten in Fila Holdings SpA, traders said.

The Fila August 45 put traded about 4,370 contracts and the September 45 put traded 4,755. The volume in the August put was equal to its open interest, suggesting an investor was closing out a position. The September put had no open interest.
